stateLimitation: Native state contains only facelet colors; it does not contain piece IDs, sticker IDs, or orientations. Candidate IDs are anchored to the known solved home and followed by moves; no arbitrary-state identity inference is valid.

presentation.cookiePreferences: CubeView3D reads preferences from document.cookie; fixture runtime must set or clear preferences deterministically.

status: Native fixture and original source bundle are packaged; candidate visible facelet trace matches Core in a local integration test. Browser rendering and owner visual acceptance remain unverified.
candidateMapping: Candidate IDs p0..p7 are assigned to known solved shell slots, sticker IDs pN.FACE to exposed faces; they are not CubeAssembler identities. The CA native facelet order is derived from CubeViewState.res#getFaceletColor.
